decisions.reason: The click-in DUOLARE adapter was announced prominently on the home page and is integral to the firm's track system, so dropping it would write off a visible commitment and expose the earlier decision, while its role as a system component keeps it useful.

This single LED luminaire was only mentioned in passing, so little public commitment protects it, but as a low-cost item close to the core range it can be carried along without needing justification, making removal only moderately likely after four years.

The home automation server box reflects investment in the strategic direction of home automation that the firm has announced, so management would likely attribute any weak sales to a market that is still maturing rather than abandon it.
The luminaire family got a dedicated page and represents investment across several variants close to the core business, which creates commitment and sunk costs that favour keeping it.
